fusions.name: Baited Carcass
fusions.desc: Baits up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles for 30 seconds. Each one bursts the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it and deals 26 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Passed Around the Table
fusions.desc: Throws poisoned bait that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dinner Bell
fusions.desc: Rings the bell: up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles are drawn onto you for 6 seconds, and healing you receive rises by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Larder of the Caught
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
